summary: Codiv serves OpenJev through a Jev-compatible API. The free public experiment supplies 100M input tokens per account and a separate 10M text-generation-token allowance, with 60 requests per minute per key. Signup is required; no credit card or paid plan is required. No enrollment end date is stated on the loaded official pages.
claim_steps: Sign up with Google, GitHub or email.
Open the dashboard and create an API key.
Call the Codiv API using the official quickstart.
